AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Small Domestic Animals 12 2.2 Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Fo.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Controlling Soil Erosion? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Controlling Soil Erosion.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Controlling Soil Erosion.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Controlling Soil Erosion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Controlling Soil Erosion.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Crop Products 11 2.3 Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good G and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Preserving Crop Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Good Grooming cleaning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
